tags.name: Data Share Bid Tape
tags.description: Aggregators can have greater confidence when pricing and valuing correspondent loans with fast easy access to key loan data and loan-level summary assessment results from Loan Product Advisor®, Loan Quality Advisor®, Loan Collateral Advisor® and Loan Closing Advisor® at the point of loan bid.

post.summary: Submit the lender loan identifier and subject property address and receive key data and loan-level summary assessment results from Loan Advisor at the point of bid.

200.description: OK Business Messages DSA901 Loan Advisor Data Share API is unable to obtain the complete set of summary results for the submitted request at this time.Please resubmit or contact Customer Support at (800-FREDDIE) for assistance. 400.description: Bad Request Error codes & details 400.001 Malformed content from the client 400.002 Request data does not match the application schema, please validate the request data. 400.005 Empty request body 400.006 Content-type must be either application/json or application/xml Business Messages DSA020 StateCode should be submitted in two character StateCode Abbreviation format. Please verify and resubmit. DSA021 Request data does not match the application schema. Please validate the request data and resubmit. DSA061 Request does not contain the bare minimum fields required to process. Please provide the full property address (addressLineText, cityName, stateCode, postalCode) along with Lender Loan Identifier. Please verify and resubmit. DSA035 The Lender Loan Identifier for attribute and length must be less than or equal to 50 characters. Please verify and resubmit.
